rationale: All 5 findings resolved in the fix-up diff. CR-001: budget sync call moved to authenticate_persistent_user after await session.commit(), so the user row is committed and visible to the new sync session before any FK insert. CR-002: _sync_one inner helper wraps the sync DB work and is dispatched via asyncio.to_thread, unblocking the event loop. CR-003: is_new_idp_user flag set in the else branch covers both the winner and race-loser paths from _create_or_recover_user. CR-004: the new outer logger.warning call includes exc_info=True. CR-005: TestSyncBudgetForIdpProjects directly tests per-project session lifecycle and per-project exception isolation; two new TestAuthenticatePersistentUser tests cover post-commit call and non-fatal failure. No new high-risk issues introduced in the fix-up.

standards_review.notes: Fix-up commit follows EPMCDME-####: Description format: 'EPMCDME-13582: Fix budget sync timing and event-loop blocking on IDP first login'
import asyncio placed correctly in stdlib imports section. asyncio.to_thread used correctly. Inner _sync_one helper cleanly separates sync/async concerns. No apparent Ruff violations.

No secrets logged — user_id sanitized with !r. Parameterized SQLAlchemy queries. Thread-pool offload does not introduce shared mutable state (each _sync_one call gets its own session). Non-fatal budget sync does not weaken authentication.

finding_status.notes: Budget sync call removed from create_user_from_idp. is_new_idp_user flag added before async with block (False), set to True in else branch. Post-commit call added in authenticate_persistent_user after await session.commit() and after the async with block closes, guaranteeing the user row is visible to the new sync session.

Inner _sync_one(project_name) sync helper wraps get_session() + _sync_project_budget_member_added + session.commit(). Per-project loop now does await asyncio.to_thread(_sync_one, project_name), offloading all sync DB work to the thread pool and freeing the asyncio event loop.

is_new_idp_user = True is set in the else branch of authenticate_persistent_user, which covers both the winner path (direct _create_first_login_user success) and the race-loser recovery path (IntegrityError caught in _create_or_recover_user, user re-fetched). Both paths set the flag; post-commit budget sync fires for either.

The old logger.warning without exc_info=True in create_user_from_idp was removed entirely. The new outer logger.warning in authenticate_persistent_user includes exc_info=True, preserving the full stack trace on outer failures.

TestSyncBudgetForIdpProjects added with test_syncs_each_project_with_committed_session (verifies _sync_project_budget_member_added called per project, session.commit called per project, correct args) and test_per_project_exception_is_swallowed_and_loop_continues (verifies first-project failure does not prevent second project). Two new TestAuthenticatePersistentUser tests cover post-commit call and non-fatal failure path.
